purpose: Teach: 四日市/東海岸/藪/鶴見/寺山/日航/本法/稲作

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、三重県四日市の公害事件の社会史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the pollution incident in Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm and steady. Leaning in slightly with genuine interest. Pace is patient, unhurried. The tone of a mentor who already knows the answer but wants to hear Ren own what he's done.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、米国東海岸都市の都市計画研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about urban planning research on East Coast American cities.
lines.style: Quick, slightly self-conscious correction. A little surprised by the mismatch. Delivered with quiet earnestness despite the moment of exposure. Keeps his shoulders still.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、藪、つまり藪医者の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the sociology of unqualified practitioners — quack doctors, in other words — didn't you?
lines.style: Gently probing. No judgment in the voice. She's testing whether he notices the pattern or is still reaching for the previous answer. Warm but deliberate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、哲学者鶴見俊輔先生のご研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the research of philosopher Tetsumi Tsurumi.
lines.style: Another gentle correction. More present this time, meeting her eyes slightly. Still earnest, but with the smallest edge of awareness that something is off. Steady delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、寺山修司の戯曲研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on drama studies of Shuji Terayama, didn't you?
lines.style: The same warm patience, but now with a flicker of something else underneath — amusement, maybe, or the kindness of letting him figure it out. Clear enunciation. Waiting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、日航機墜落事故の社会記憶の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about social memory and the JAL Flight 123 disaster.
lines.style: Slightly firmer now. The pattern is landing. He delivers this one with more presence, less apology. Still earnest, but aware. His voice stays level.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本法、つまり当該法律の解釈研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on legal interpretation — the interpretation of applicable law — didn't you?
lines.style: The same steady warmth. But now there's clear affection underneath. She knows he knows. Delivered with an almost imperceptible smile in the voice. Patient still, but the patience has shifted to gentleness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、東北地方の稲作の伝統研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the traditions of rice cultivation in the Tohoku region.
lines.style: Delivered with quiet, wry realization. A small exhale that's almost a laugh. He's caught. Still earnest in delivery, but now it lands as self-aware. The final word trails slightly, like acceptance.
